snippet.title: Brutal FPS Retro Shooter | Red Light #fps #shooter #singleplayer
snippet.description:
Red Light is a retro-styled extraction shooter where you take a mission to raid an abandoned Soviet R&D Institute filled with mercenaries and living results of human experiments to solve the mystery of your disappeared brother.

Play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486770/Red_Light/

#fps #shooter #shootergames #indiegames #lowpoly #retroshooter #gaming
